test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: HVAC system selection does NOT depend on the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __number of tubes.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• HVAC system selection__ is dependent on factors such as climate condition, owner’s desire, and building configuration.
 
• The __number of tubes__ is not a determining factor in the selection of an HVAC system.
 
• HVAC systems are designed to provide heating, ventilation, and air conditioning based on specific building and environmental requirements.
 
• Climate conditions play a crucial role as HVAC systems must be capable of adapting to temperature variations and humidity levels.
 
• Building configuration, including space layout and size, influences the design and installation of HVAC systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **HVAC System Types:**

 
 
• There are various types of HVAC systems, such as split systems, hybrid systems, and duct-free systems, tailored to meet specific requirements.
 
• Each type of system offers unique advantages based on energy efficiency and installation needs.
 
 
 
• **Energy Efficiency:**
 
 
• Modern HVAC systems focus on energy-efficient technologies to reduce operational costs and environmental impact.
